The academic skills that autistic students bring to higher education are often tempered by social, emotional, and self-regulative challenges. The body of research focusing on autistic learners’ experiences in higher education is currently limited and focused primarily on fully in-person and online course models. title: Judging Turn-Taking Through a Monocultural Lens: A Parallel-Corpus Probe of Cultural Bias in LLMs
venue: Companion Publication of the International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI Companion)
why_it_matters: Turn-taking and backchanneling are governed by culture-specific display rules: the same listener behavior that signals attentive engagement in one language community can read as interruption or disengagement in another.
